notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of four or greater.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
